prompt: 如果我当时更努力适应，我就会少一些误会。哪一句正确？

choices.text: If I adapted faster, I would have had fewer misunderstandings
If I had adapted faster, I would have less misunderstandings
If I have adapted faster, I would have fewer misunderstandings
If I had adapted faster, I would have had fewer misunderstandings

explanation: 与过去相反：had adapted 配 would have had。fewer 修饰可数的 misunderstandings。
verify: "If I had adapted faster, I would have had fewer misunderstandings"

prompt: If she ___ abroad earlier, she would have been more fluent. 横线处填哪一个？
explanation: 从句用 had gone。

prompt: 哪一句是与过去事实相反？

choices.text: If he asked his host, he would avoid the mistake now
If he had asked his host, he would have avoided the mistake
If he had asked, he will avoid it
If he asks, he would have avoided it

explanation: had asked 配 would have avoided。

prompt: If they ___ the custom, they would not have been so homesick. 横线处填哪一个？
explanation: 与过去相反的从句用 had understood。

prompt: 如果当时听了主人的建议，我现在就会更流利。哪一句正确？

choices.text: If I had followed the advice, I would be more fluent now

prompt: If she had stayed abroad, she ___ the language now. 横线处填哪一个？

prompt: 哪一句是错综时间？

prompt: 主句有 now 时，更常见的谓语是哪一种？
explanation: 现在的结果用 would do，不用 would have done。

prompt: 想说如果当时问了主人就不会误会，哪一句合适？

choices.text: If I had known the custom, I would not have felt homesick now

prompt: 想礼貌地承认自己还不够流利，哪一句合适？

I am not fluent yet, so I may misunderstand
